notes: «من ولد عباد بن عبد الله بن الزبير» describes عبد الوهاب's family; it is not written as a transmitter, so it is not a link
the second «عبد الله بن الزبير» (after «عن») is the link; the first is inside the descriptor
the «قال أبو عيسى» remark after the matn is the compiler's comment, not a chain
